rss_assessment.scope: local acceptance assessment; not reviewer or merge approval
rss_assessment.explanation: Current corrected-source whole-file controls retain all four runs. Kernel command/largest-child maxima rise 0.332% on evaluator and 0.171% on VM; these small increases are disclosed, not rounded to zero. Sampled simultaneous family RSS falls 11.879% on evaluator but rises 14.966% on VM (401,648 → 461,760 KiB). The VM sampled peak moves from MethodCall#test_argument_forwarding on main to Literal#test_hash_literal on this runtime; the dominant child high-water marks remain 316,899,328 → 317,440,000 bytes. Evaluator peaks likewise move from array literal to hash literal. The family metric counts simultaneous resident pages across runner, forked child and wrappers, and is not one process's heap. Peak-event components and every high-water measurement are retained. This does not establish a material retained-memory regression; the sampled-family increase remains visible for review. All 76 case outcomes remain identical under tight GC and seed 1. This local assessment permits final correctness checks and is separate from external review and owner merge. Earlier main7a/source60d4 samples retain their original identities.

pmu_assessment.scope: local acceptance assessment; not reviewer or merge approval
pmu_assessment.explanation: Ordinary method/block/matrix totals range from -0.037% to +0.334%. The increases remain explicit; no material ordinary-call regression is established at this scale. Evaluator anonymous-rest controls improve 5.313% for direct calls and 6.526% for borrowed sources. VM borrowed-source forwarding improves 0.807%, while the direct anonymous-rest control increases 0.621%; no claim of universal VM improvement is made. The keyword-expression classification is confined to calls that already have a splat, and no counting-only operation or dummy Ruby object is added to every ordinary call. This is a local performance assessment, not external approval.
